name: Satsuki to Shoko 2
source:
'Satsuki, I'm interested in doll memorial services."

An abandoned house, ghost photos, and finally... dolls!
Satsuki and Shoko are two high school girls who love the occult.
One day, Shoko is cursed by a doll (or so she claims).

[Edited and Translated from [url=https://freegame-mugen.jp/adventure/game_3889.html]Freegame Mugen[/url]]
translation:
“さつき，我对人偶供养很感兴趣。”

废屋、灵异照片，还有…人偶！
さつき与ショーコ是两个热爱神秘学的女高中生。
某天，ショーコ遭到了人偶的诅咒，至少她自己是这么说的。

[编译自[url=https://freegame-mugen.jp/adventure/game_3889.html]Freegame Mugen[/url]]
